---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new standard, playbook, scaffold, prompt, rule, or example
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to add?

Describe the feature, content, or artifact you'd like to see added.

## Which area does this belong to?

- [ ] Standard (new engineering standard or guideline)
- [ ] Playbook (new framework or stack guide)
- [ ] Scaffold (new project template)
- [ ] Prompt (new AI assistant integration)
- [ ] Rule (new linting or validation rule)
- [ ] Example (new complete application example)
- [ ] Tool (new CLI or utility script)
- [ ] Documentation

## Why is this needed?

Explain the problem it solves or the gap it fills. What is missing today?

## Do you have a draft or reference?

Paste a draft, link to a reference implementation, or describe the approach you'd suggest.

## Target stack (if applicable)

Which technology or framework does this apply to?

## Effort estimate

- [ ] Small — content addition to an existing file
- [ ] Medium — new file or section
- [ ] Large — new scaffold, example, or significant new content
